objectives.syllabus_guidance: Teach random, systematic and stratified sampling; enquiry planning, instruments, pilot, representation, evidence and practical project responses. No cluster/quota/snowball sampling or inferential statistics. Prioritise suitable bar/pie/divided-rectangle forms; no generated line-graph practice, following report advice (not a syllabus ban).

papers_note: Papers 1/2 draw on whole curriculum; topic 10.1 planning focuses on Paper 3. Research can use any content context. This teaching allocation is judgement, not a claim that research terminology cannot occur on other papers.
